_meta.description: World Cup 2026 player injuries — post-June-1 squad deadline update. DOUBTFUL statuses resolved against final 26-man squad announcements.
changes_v3.0: ter Stegen (Germany): DOUBTFUL→OUT (torn thigh, NOT in squad — ESPN). Penalty -15→0 (backup GK, Neuer #1).
Wataru Endo (Japan): DOUBTFUL→FIT (in final squad, 'back on grass' — ESPN). Penalty -15→0.
Takumi Minamino (Japan): DOUBTFUL→OUT (resumed training but NOT in final 26 — ESPN). Already -5 role.
Lamine Yamal (Spain): kept DOUBTFUL — partially torn hamstring, likely misses MD1+MD2 (ESPN).
Mikel Merino (Spain): kept DOUBTFUL — fractured foot, no games since Feb. Return June 4 target.
Cristian Romero (Argentina): kept DOUBTFUL — partially torn MCL, 'World Cup in jeopardy' (ESPN). Return June 17 target, misses MD1.
Mohammed Kudus (Ghana): kept DOUBTFUL — hamstring setback after quad injury. Return June 18 target.
Alphonso Davies (Canada): kept DOUBTFUL — 'several weeks' (Bayern). Canada starts June 12.
NEW: Fermín López (Spain): OUT — metatarsal fracture, surgery required (ESPN). Important MF.
NEW: Nico Williams (Spain): DOUBTFUL — muscular injury May 10 vs Valencia (Sports Mole).
NEW: Neymar (Brazil): DOUBTFUL — calf issue since May 17, may miss opener vs Morocco (ESPN).
NEW: Nahuel Molina (Argentina): DOUBTFUL — thigh injury, expected 2-3 weeks (ESPN). May miss group stage start.
NEW: Ben White (England): OUT — severe knee injury. Another England defensive blow.
NEW: Jarrad Branthwaite (England): OUT — severe thigh injury.
NEW: Jack Grealish (England): OUT — season-ending foot injury.
NEW: Jurriën Timber (Netherlands): DOUBTFUL — groin, not played since March 14 (ESPN).
NEW: Arda Güler (Turkey): DOUBTFUL — hamstring, return June 14 target.
England: Foden/Palmer/TAA OUT confirmed (all missing from final squad). Added White/Branthwaite/Grealish OUT → total -125.
Brazil: Neymar added as DOUBTFUL (-15).
Canada: Davies severity upgraded (hamstring, 'several weeks').
